facts.statement: Perplexity released a Windows version of Personal Computer in July 2026.
facts.support: The source states that Perplexity AI Inc. today released a Windows version of Personal Computer, expanding its agentic automation software beyond the original Macintosh platform.

facts.statement: Personal Computer for Windows allows users to manage work through a single conversational interface.
facts.support: The source mentions that the Windows version can combine local files and applications with information from Microsoft 365 and websites, allowing users to manage the work through a single conversational interface.

facts.statement: Perplexity's Personal Computer is intended to overcome AI assistants' inability to access locally stored information.
facts.support: The source states that Personal Computer is intended to overcome the inability of many AI assistants to work with information stored locally or operate across the collection of applications that employees use.

facts.statement: Perplexity competes directly with Microsoft by offering an alternative to Copilot and AI agents in Windows.
facts.support: The source notes that Perplexity is now more directly in competition with Microsoft Corp., which is incorporating Copilot and AI agents throughout Windows and its productivity applications.

facts.statement: Perplexity expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows in July 2026, turning PCs into local AI systems.
facts.support: The source states that Perplexity launched an updated version of its agentic Personal Computer tool for Windows in July 2026, allowing any PC running the OS to function as a local AI system.

facts.statement: The Windows version operates like a general-purpose digital worker capable of performing tasks such as creating documents and updating spreadsheets.
facts.support: The text describes the new Windows version as functioning like a 'general-purpose digital worker' that can access files and apps to perform user tasks.

facts.statement: Personal Computer for Windows integrates with Microsoft Office 365, Teams, and other enterprise tools.
facts.support: Perplexity noted in its press release that users can now ask the tool to work across local files, Microsoft Office 365, and the web in one place.

facts.statement: The tool is available to paying Max and Enterprise Max users starting from $200 per month.
facts.support: The source mentions that the new version is being rolled out today to paying Max and Enterprise Max users with subscription tiers beginning at $200 monthly.

facts.statement: Perplexity launched Personal Computer for Windows, allowing Windows PCs to be used as locally run AI systems.
facts.support: The source states that Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, enabling computers running the world’s most popular OS to function as a locally run AI system.

facts.statement: Personal Computer for Windows operates similarly to the Mac version launched in April.
facts.support: According to The Verge's report, the Windows version functions identically to its Mac predecessor, acting like a digital employee capable of creating documents and managing files.

facts.statement: The expansion targets Windows' large user base of 1.4 billion users.
facts.support: Perplexity is expanding the agentic automation tool to an OS that powers nearly 70% of desktop computers worldwide, targeting 1.4 billion potential users.

facts.statement: Personal Computer for Windows operates entirely on-device without relying on cloud-based tools.
facts.support: The source mentions that Personal Computer for Windows operates entirely on-device, accessing local files and applications to perform tasks typically requiring manual human intervention.

facts.statement: The tool allows Windows PCs to function as locally run AI systems.
facts.support: Source describes it as a 'general-purpose digital work' system for Windows.
